title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.03330v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs without per-LLM fitting, and no law names the factors that set it. From closed-form expressions of LLM inference's computational and memory-access complexity, we derive the SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy (SIMPLE), a four-parameter law that separates prefill from decode, and decode into KV-cache and next-token computation cost. Over traces of 13 dense LLMs from several families on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it attains R2 = 0.969 and 11.97% MAPE, 3.1-3.5x below the SOTA, without per-LLM calibration. translated_abstract: 生成式AI按token计费，但并非所有token的成本都相同。每个token都会进入KV缓存，并推高后续token的成本，因此能耗沿着一个由表面相同的token组成的序列呈非线性增长。目前既没有分析模型能在无需针对每个LLM进行拟合的情况下说明单个token的成本，也没有定律指出决定这一成本的因素。基于LLM推理的计算复杂度和内存访问复杂度的闭式表达式，我们推导出了SIMPLE（SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy，即用于预测LLM能耗的SIMPLE推理模型），这是一个四参数定律，它将预填充与解码阶段分离，并将解码阶段进一步分解为KV缓存成本与下一token计算成本。在NVIDIA H100 GPU上对来自多个系列共13个稠密LLM的运行轨迹进行验证，该模型达到了R²=0.969和11.97%的MAPE，误差比SOTA低3.1–3.5倍，且无需针对每个LLM进行校准。SIMPLE不仅能够预测，还能解释：预填充能耗随隐藏维度呈二次增长，因此越大的LLM在长输入下受影响越严重；更高的GQA KV分组则能减少……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SIMPLE——一个无需针对每个LLM校准的四参数解析定律，通过将LLM推理能耗分解为预填充、KV缓存和下一token计算成本来精确预测能耗，在13个稠密LLM上达到R²=0.969，误差比SOTA低3.1–3.5倍。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SIMPLE, a four-parameter analytical law that predicts LLM inference energy by separating prefill from decode (KV-cache and next-token computation) costs without per-LLM calibration, achieving R²=0.969 and 3.1–3.5x lower error than SOTA across 13 dense LLMs on H100 GPUs.
